description: Find operations of the DCAST Partner API by what you want to do. Returns ranked operations with operationId, method, path and a one-line summary. This covers the WHOLE documented API (streams, videos, restreams, rooms, playlists, webhooks, analytics, booking, notifications, site and domains, team, support and more), not only the typed tools in this list. Query with a few specific words, for example "create webhook", "room poll", "restream destination", "playlist add video". Then call dcast_describe_operation for the exact request. Never invent an operationId, field or endpoint.

limit.description: How many operations to return, default 10

query.description: A few words about the job, for example "create webhook" or "room quiz"

tag.description: Optional area filter, for example Rooms, Webhooks, Streams, Videos

name: dcast_find_operation
title: Find a DCAST API operation
